newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY - RED WINGS PLACE SERGEI FEDOROV ON SEVEN-DAY INJURED LIST.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY - RED WINGS PLACE SERGEI FEDOROV ON SEVEN-DAY INJURED LIST.

text.p: The Detroit Red Wings had to put Sergei Fedorov on the seven-day injured reserve list with a groin injury on Monday, just when the Russian centre appeared to be regaining his scoring touch.
Fedorov was placed on injured reserve retroactive to January 9. He suffered the injury in Detroit's 5-4 overtime victory Thursday at Phoenix.
Fedorov, the 1994 Hart Trophy winner as the National Hockey League's Most Valuable Player, is third on the team in scoring with 19 goals and 19 assists in 42 games.
He was struggling earlier this season, but had rebounded with seven goals and six assists in his last seven games before suffering the injury.

To fill Fedorov's spot on the roster, the Red Wings recalled rookie left winger Tomas Holmstrom of Adirondack of the American Hockey League. The 23-year-old Swede has two goals and two assists in 17 games with Detroit.
